assignments.briefing: Kill the requisite enemies to ensure early investors in the TD-110 Maelstrom Tanks receive their promised deluxe features.
assignments.title: MAJOR ORDER

active_campaign.title: ARMORED EAGLE
active_campaign.label: ACTIVE CAMPAIGN
active_campaign.description: A patriotic defense contractor has agreed to fabricate personal-defense tanks for citizen use. The Helldivers are called upon to secure the resources and territory necessary to protect our citizens' right to self-defense.
active_campaign.description_cn: 一家爱国的防务承包商已同意为公民制造个人防卫坦克。绝地潜兵奉命夺取必要的资源与领土，以捍卫公民的自卫权。

phases.title: Secure Territory
phases.briefing:
The Ministry of Defense has signed a new agreement with AM Defense, the patriotic contractor responsible for the high-quality line of FRVs, to construct a new tank model: the Maelstrom Tank. In an exciting new frontier for civilian freedom, the Tank will be made available for purchase to qualifying citizens. 

Enemy aggression, however, threatens this Freedom, by denying AM Defense the territory recently allocated for Maelstrom Tank construction. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate MARFARK and PHACT BAY immediately.

AM Defense has graciously provided, free of charge, prototype Maelstrom Tank models to augment Helldiver arsenals for the liberation of this territory.
phases.briefing_cn:
国防部已与 AM Defense 签署新协议，建造一款新型坦克：TD-110 “风暴漩涡”坦克。这家爱国的承包商正是那条高质量快速侦察载具产品线的制造商。作为公民自由的全新前沿，符合条件的公民将可购买该型坦克。

然而，敌人的侵略正在威胁这份自由：他们不让 AM Defense 获得近期划拨给“风暴漩涡”坦克生产线的领土。绝地潜兵奉命立即解放玛尔法克与丈人一湾。

AM Defense 已慷慨地无偿提供“风暴漩涡”坦克原型车，用于充实绝地潜兵的军械库，以完成这片领土的解放。

phases.title: Resource Acquisition
phases.briefing:
Production of Maelstrom Tanks for civilian and military use is proceeding on schedule. Now, deluxe features offered as incentives for early investors must be fabricated. The Helldivers are ordered to dismantle 5,000,000 Automaton Tanks to repurpose their engine cooling systems as climate-controlled cupholders, and harvest 25,000,000 Chargers to convert their carapaces to vibration-insulation panels.

AM Defense has invested heavily in tank production, taking on significant debt in the process—a patriotic risk to improve the security of all citizens. Disruption to investor confidence at this critical juncture could jeopardize the project, and AM Defense itself. It is imperative the Helldivers secure these resources.
phases.briefing_cn:
用于民用和军用的风暴漩涡坦克生产正按计划进行。现在，必须制造作为早期投资者激励的豪华配置。绝地潜兵奉命拆解5,000,000辆机器人坦克，将其引擎冷却系统改作恒温杯架，并采集25,000,000只Charger，将其甲壳转化为隔振板。

AM Defense已大举投资坦克生产，并在此过程中承担了巨额债务——这是一项旨在提升全体平民安全的爱国风险。在这一关键时刻动摇投资者信心，可能危及该项目以及AM Defense本身。绝地潜兵必须确保这些资源。

news.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

Production of Maelstrom Tanks for civilian and military use is proceeding on schedule. Now, deluxe features offered as incentives for early investors must be fabricated. The Helldivers are ordered to dismantle 5,000,000 Automaton Tanks to repurpose their engine cooling systems as climate-controlled cupholders, and harvest 25,000,000 Chargers to convert their carapaces to vibration-insulation panels.
news.translated:
新重要指令

“风暴漩涡”坦克的民用与军用生产正按计划推进。如今，作为早期投资者激励的豪华配置必须投入制造。绝地潜兵奉命拆解 500 万（5,000,000）台机器人坦克，将其引擎冷却系统改作恒温杯架；并猎杀 2500 万（25,000,000）只冲锋虫，将其甲壳改作隔振板。

news.original:
MAJOR ORDER WON

The Helldivers liberated PHACT BAY and MARFARK. AM Defense has already broken ground on massive factories for large-scale Maelstrom Tank fabrication. Pre-orders from qualifying citizens for home defense Tanks have already sold out, evidencing the eagerness of Super Earth citizens to exercise their natural-born freedoms.
news.translated:
重要指令达成

绝地潜兵解放了丈人一湾与玛尔法克。AM 国防部已破土动工，兴建超大型工厂，用于大规模制造“风暴漩涡”坦克。符合资格的公民已抢购一空家用防御坦克的预售份额，足见超级地球公民行使与生俱来自由的迫切之心。

news.original:
STRATEGIC ALERT

The Automaton Incineration Corps has been reported on VINDEMITARIX PRIME.
news.translated:
战略警报

据报，机器人炽灼部队已出现在文德米塔里克斯主星。

news.original:
MINOR TERMINID OUTBREAK

A minor Terminid outbreak has occured on FRONTERIA. It is evident that some dissidents continue their hopeless effort to disrupt citizen confidence in the TCS+. The Helldivers are ordered to put down this small, low-threat outbreak.
news.translated:
终结族小规模爆发

边陲发生小规模终结族爆发。显然，仍有少数异见分子执迷不悟，妄图动摇公民对TCS+的信心。绝地潜兵受命扑灭这场规模小、威胁低的爆发。

news.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

Enemy aggression prevents the long-term construction of the new Maelstrom Tank, threatening our citizens' inherent right to self-defense. Liberate MARFARK and PHACT BAY immediately.
news.translated:
新重要指令

敌方侵略行径，令新型「风暴漩涡」坦克无法长期建造，公民固有的自卫权因此受到威胁。立刻解放玛尔法克与丈人一湾。

news.original:
STRATEGIC UPDATE

Miscalibrations in the Democracy Space Station have required it to be taken temporarily offline in order to be resolved. The Ministry of Defense has shifted significant personnel to these fixes, making it a top priority. 

Those responsible for the mistakes will attend an intensive re-training seminar. If the issue persists, their families will also attend the seminar.
news.translated:
战略通报

民主空间站出现校准偏差，须暂时下线以完成修复。国防部已调派大量人员投入此项工作，并将其列为最高优先级。

对失误负有责任者，将参加强化再培训研讨班。若问题仍未解决，其家属亦须一同参加。

news.original:
CAMPAIGN FAILURE

Cyborg interference has raised significant doubts in the veracity of the Quarter-Term Elections. As a result, a re-vote has been ordered, with enhanced election security measures to make interference impossible.

SEAF Battalions have been recalled from the frontlines to secure voting sites.
news.translated:
战役失败

生化人的干涉行为，令期中选举的真实性受到严重质疑。为此，重新投票已获下令，并配以更严密的选举安保措施，确保干涉绝无可能。

SEAF各营已从前线召回，负责守卫投票站点。

news.original:
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION

Funds from the Super Secure Elections Act have been allocated to support Helldiver operations on ROGUE 5 with the Anti-Personnel Mine Deployer Stratagem for the next 24 hours.
news.translated:
军械库扩充

《超级安全选举法》拨款已到位，未来24小时内，罗格5上的绝地潜兵行动将获得「反步兵地雷部署器」战略配备支援。

news.original:
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION

Funds from the Super Secure Elections Act have been allocated to support Helldiver operations on CHARON PRIME with the Gas Mines Stratagem for the next 24 hours.
news.translated:
军械库扩充

《超级安全选举法》拨款已划拨，用于支援绝地潜兵在卡戎主星的行动，未来 24 小时内提供「毒气地雷」战略配备。

major_order.title: MAJOR ORDER
major_order.brief: Kill the requisite enemies to ensure early investors in the TD-110 Maelstrom Tanks receive their promised deluxe features.
major_order.translated_brief: 消灭指定数量的敌人，确保“风暴漩涡”坦克的早期投资者获得承诺的豪华配置。
